package.description: A cross-platform music app using YouTube Music for backend

en-US.description: A cross-platform music app using YouTube Music for backend
en-US.longDescription:
A FOSS YouTube Music client for Android and Desktop with many features from Spotify, SponsorBlock, ReturnYouTubeDislike using Compose Multiplatform to develop.
- Play music from YouTube Music or YouTube for free, without ads and in the background
- Browsing Home, Charts, Podcast, Moods & Genre with YouTube Music data at high speed
- Search everything on YouTube
- Analyze your playing data, create custom playlists, and sync with YouTube Music...
- Spotify Canvas supported
- Play 1080p video option with subtitle
- AI song suggestions
- Customize your playlist, synced with YouTube Music
- Notifications from followed artists
- Caching and offline playback support
- Synced lyrics from SimpMusic Lyrics, LRCLIB, Spotify (require login) and YouTube Transcript - AI lyrics translation (BETA) (*)
- Personalize data (**) and multi-YouTube-account support
- Supports SponsorBlock and Return YouTube Dislike
- Sleep Timer
- Android Auto with online content
- Discord Rich Presence support
- And many more!
(*) Use your OpenAI or Gemini API key
(**) For users who chose "Send back to Google" feature
Warning
This app is in the beta stage, so it may have many bugs and make it crash. If you find any bugs,
please create an issue or contact me via email or Discord server.
Because of depending on YouTube Music, the player error will happen and it's normally, please don't ask me about the stable state of this app.
en-US.name: SimpMusic

zh-CN.description: 一款使用 YouTube Music 作为后端的跨平台音乐应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
一款基于 Compose Multiplatform 开发的开源免费 YouTube Music 客户端，支持 Android 和桌面平台，具备来自 Spotify、SponsorBlock、ReturnYouTubeDislike 等多项功能：
- 免费播放来自 YouTube Music 或 YouTube 的音乐，无广告且支持后台播放
- 高速浏览 YouTube Music 提供的首页、排行榜、播客、心情与流派内容
- 搜索 YouTube 上的全部内容
- 分析您的播放数据，创建个性化播放列表，并与 YouTube Music 同步
- 支持 Spotify Canvas 动态封面
- 支持带字幕的 1080p 视频播放
- AI 推荐歌曲
- 自定义播放列表，并与 YouTube Music 同步
- 跟随艺术家的通知提醒
- 支持缓存和离线播放
- 支持从 SimpMusic Lyrics、LRCLIB、Spotify（需登录）和 YouTube 字幕中同步歌词 — AI 歌词翻译（测试版）(*)
- 支持个性化数据（**）和多个 YouTube 账号
- 支持 SponsorBlock 和 Return YouTube Dislike
- 睡眠定时器
- 支持 Android Auto 在线内容播放
- 支持 Discord Rich Presence
- 更多功能等你发现！
(*) 需使用您自己的 OpenAI 或 Gemini API 密钥
(**) 仅适用于选择“发送回 Google”功能的用户
警告
本应用尚处于测试阶段，可能存在较多 Bug 并导致闪退。如发现任何问题，
请通过创建 Issue、电子邮件或 Discord 服务器联系我。
由于本应用依赖 YouTube Music，播放器出现错误属正常现象，请勿向我咨询应用的稳定性问题。
